note: Two ways to make this pack. The committed MP3s were generated by the `kokoro` block with the af_heart voice (US English) — Kokoro-82M ships no Australian voice, so American or British (bf_/bm_) are the English options. The top-level model/voice/instructions drive only the optional OpenAI path (`npm run narration:generate:openai`); its instructions may ask for an accent that path can actually produce.
instructions: Speak like a warm, unhurried parent guiding one curious five-year-old. Calm, natural and friendly, never announcer-like or sing-song. Use short pauses between ideas, clear consonants, and a gently excited tone. Do not rush. Do not add words that are not in the script.

cues.arrival-earth: We made it to Earth! This is our home seen from space. Tap a gold target to discover a real place.
cues.arrival-moon: We made it to the Moon! There is no air or weather here. Tap a gold target to discover a real place.
cues.arrival-mars: We made it to Mars! Its red dust is full of rust. Tap a gold target to discover a real place.
cues.discovery-earth-sahara: You found the Sahara! It is the biggest hot desert in the world, and it is enormous even from space.
cues.discovery-earth-amazon: You found the Amazon rainforest! More kinds of animals live here than anywhere else on Earth.
cues.discovery-earth-nightside: You found Earth's night side! Those tiny glows are towns and cities full of people.
cues.discovery-moon-tranquility: You found the Apollo 11 landing place! The astronauts' footprints are still there because there is no wind or rain.
cues.discovery-moon-tycho: You found Tycho! A crashing space rock splashed those bright streaks of dust across the Moon.
cues.discovery-moon-farside: You found the Moon's far side! People never saw this side until a spacecraft flew around it.
cues.discovery-mars-olympus: You found Olympus Mons! It is the biggest volcano in the whole solar system.
cues.discovery-mars-marineris: You found Valles Marineris! This giant crack is longer than Australia is wide.
cues.discovery-mars-elysium: You found Elysium Mons! This volcano would still be twice as tall as Earth's tallest mountain.
cues.hunt-earth: One more is hiding. Swipe the planet sideways to look around the back.
cues.hunt-moon: One more is hiding. Swipe the Moon sideways to look around the back.
cues.hunt-mars: One more is hiding. Swipe Mars sideways to look around the back.
cues.success-earth: You found all three places on Earth!
cues.success-moon: You found all three places on the Moon!
cues.success-mars: You found all three places on Mars!
cues.spin-earth: Watch the sunlight move while Earth turns. The bright side is day, and the dark side is night.
cues.arrival-saturn: We made it to Saturn! This is the planet with the beautiful rings. Tap a gold target to find something real.
cues.discovery-saturn-rings: You found the rings! They are billions of pieces of ice and rock going round Saturn, from tiny crumbs to lumps as big as a house.
cues.discovery-saturn-hexagon: You found the six-sided storm! Right at the top of Saturn is a giant cloud shaped like a hexagon, with six straight sides.
cues.discovery-saturn-storm: You found a giant storm! Saturn's storms are far bigger than any on Earth, and they can rumble on for months.
cues.hunt-saturn: One more is hiding. Swipe Saturn sideways to look around the back.
cues.success-saturn: You found all three! You have been all the way out to Saturn.
